guidance_issued_by: Colorado Education Initiative (nonprofit), linked and supplemented by the Colorado Department of Education
unique_context: Colorado's guidance is a public-private artifact: the Colorado Roadmap for AI in K-12 Education (Colorado Education Initiative, August 2024) with its 'If and How' decision checklist and AI Resource Evaluation Tool, hosted alongside CDE's own AI competency profiles for students, educators, administrators and specialized service providers. Nothing is mandatory; districts implement individually.
notes: CDE's AI page states it does not endorse listed resources and cites FERPA/COPPA as the binding constraints. A proposed 2025-26 ballot initiative (#148, 'AI-Powered Education') would create AI-delivered instruction with adult 'guides'; it is not law.
